import ast, json, pathlib
root = pathlib.Path(".")
files = sorted(root.rglob("*.py"))
for path in files:
    ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=path.as_posix())
models = ast.parse((root / "httpx/models.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
url_class = next(node for node in models.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == "URL")
methods = {node.name for node in url_class.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)}
exports = (root / "httpx/__init__.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert {"__init__", "copy_with"} <= methods
assert "from .models import (" in exports and "    URL," in exports
print(json.dumps({"public_url_export_found": True, "python_files_parsed": len(files), "url_methods_found": sorted({"__init__", "copy_with"} & methods)}, sort_keys=True))
